description: GPS L1 C/A full receiver (T-323): GNSS-SDR exec'd as a subprocess behind hk-plugin-gnss-sdr, never linked (ADR-0010). The wrapper records each contiguous dwell of ci8 L1 IQ to a scratch file, runs gnss-sdr (acquisition, DLL/PLL tracking, nav decode, RTKLIB PVT) over it, and emits its RINEX 3 observations and NMEA fixes as decode lines of schema hackriff.gnss/1: one per observation epoch plus one dwell summary. Evidence only: no identity (no Emitter upsert) and no annotation. It buffers to disk, so it reports ready at once.
